text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaah! W-we'll never make it! There are
still so many costumes to
make, to say
nothing about our sign!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Well, we could only really expect to lose
some folks right about now. It's not just
Palmer and Helios who've gotta prepare
for the upcoming
racing season.

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Don't forget the other classes and teams
are prepping exhibits too. We're in peak
busy season right now.
It's all up to us to build the
throne then, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Urgh... Hey, you over there! Don't worry
about the throne. Just move
on to the next
thing on the list!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you serious? It's so much more
simple than what you had
planned out,
though...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one who's gonna be sitting on
it, so
what do you care? I'm
tired of watching
over all of this. Let's just move on!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wait up! Well, I suppose we could
make it somehow if we
skipped this...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(Thusly, the days did pass,
until the eve of
the Solefall Faire finally
arrived.)

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: We. Did. It!

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
We actually made it! I was seriously
worried there for a bit!

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
You can say that again!
I can't wait to see
what everyone thinks
tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, well I suppose some praise is in
order, my legion! Good work,
and rest well
tonight. There's just a little left to do
tomorrow morning!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Doto is in a meeting right now, so one of
you go tell her that we're
done here.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll go let her know. See you
tomorrow, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
And what do you think you're doing,
Digital? You need to head back
too.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Oh, um,
yeah! For sure! But uh... as it
stands...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Can we really say that the Demonic Castle
is complete?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Your humble servant recalls a different
vision! The plans you had laid
out—they
had more...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
More oomph! More demonic power! More
tricksy charm! Everything
was positively
bursting with your vision!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
'Twas akin to the fanciest of storybooks,
decked out with special
paper and gold
leaf!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...I don't really get what you're saying.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Uwah, please forgive me! But r-really...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Are we really going to end our work here?
Oh, they do let people stay the night in
the school building right before the
Solefall Faire! I'll
just go ask—

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I said we're done! Your job here is done!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm just gonna... do the rest by myself.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-all by yourself?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Oh, shut it! Just go home already! Get
outta my way, useless minion!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I swear, I can't rely on any of you for
anything! I gave you one simple
instruction
and you can't even do that right!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
So your queen is going to do everything
by herself! Just go home
already!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eek!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So that's how it went. Maybe I shouldn't
have left without putting up
more of a
fight...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I see... Windy...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I understand... truly,
I do! I can see that
this is just another example of
our liege's
benevolent nature...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Just the fact that we got this far without
Palmer, Helios, and the
others is amazing...
We should be proud of what we were able to
achieve!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I can feel that she doesn't want us to
sweat the details, but she also
doesn't want any
compromises! That's why she's trying to do
it all
herself! I don't want to just stand idly
by...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
But my oshi said it plainly:
"I'll do the rest
myself." Who am I to go
against her
wishes?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, Digital. These, um, "oshis" that you
keep on mentioning. Are they
like people
that you admire or something?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Uh,
y-yeah! There's a bit more to it,
I'll admit, but I think that's
a good way to
think of it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I see... Uh... Um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Digital, m-maybe it's not my place to say
this, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-are you sure you're fine with leaving
her
alone like that, then?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I also...
have someone who I really admire.
She's stronger than anyone, radiant, and
never backs down from a challenge. She
seems the type to be okay on her own.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: And because I look up to her, I know her skills and majesty well enough to realize she is fine on her own... But at the same time...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I don't... ever want to leave her on her
own.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I wish to be... her friend.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Friend... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I never would have thought I'd get to hang
out and become such
good friends with
you, Digital.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (I had always thought the relationship between an otaku and her oshis was a one-way street. That it simply had to be.)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: (But... maybe in this case...)

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
(The smallest of holes poked through that
filter I prefer to live
behind... and as it did,
the fresh air hit me with such a force...)
